name: Polymer and Fibre Physics
description: Polymer properties required for fibre forming polymers, factors affecting the physical and chemical properties of fibres: chemical structure, molecular architecture and supramolecular morphology. Configuration/conformation; tacticity and stereoregular polymers, crystalline and amorphous regions, orientation, fibre structure models. Crystallization in polymers: factors affecting crystallization; crystallization temperature and kinetics; glass transition and melting temperature, viscoelasticity, viscoelastic models, dynamic mechanical properties, WLF equation and time temperature relationship. Behavior of polymer solutions, characterization techniques: density, thermal properties (DSC/TGA/DMA/TMA), FTIR, XRD, SEM, optical microscopy, birefringence, creep and flexural rigidity properties, mechanical, electrical, optical and moisture absorption properties of fibres.
